name: Hans Christian 38T

specs.sparredLengthSource: owner's measurement on hull Symphony, 2026-10-16; LOA excludes bowsprit and stern spar

notes: All points are pixels in the 600x745 drawing, read by hand off gridded enlargements and snapped to dark pixels where a column scan found the line. Bow is to the right in both views.
The drawing superimposes an accommodation plan (top) on a sail-plan profile (bottom), on one shared x scale: the bowsprit tip sits at x 577 in both.
Profile hull, transom top to stem head, spans x 34 to 478 = 444 px for an LOA of 37.92 ft, 11.71 px/ft. Draft reads 6.15 ft (spec 6.0), LWL 34.0 ft (spec 33.0), beam 12.4 ft (spec 12.33).

The plan's aft end at x 17 is a boomkin, not the transom: the drawing's full extent, x 17 to the bowsprit tip at x 577, is 560 px = 47.8 ft, matching the owner's ~47 ft sparred length. The profile does not draw the boomkin (its backstay lands on the transom top), so it is taken from the plan only, at deck height.

Inferred: forward of plan x 440 the drawn outline runs straight on to the bowsprit roller (pulpit and platform drawn continuous with the sheer). The deck is closed to the profile's stem head at x 478 by hand; the four points from x 455 on are a guess, not a trace.
